title: alternanthera helleri
intro: Alternanthera helleri, commonly known as Joseph's Coat, is a species of flowering plant in the amaranth family, native to tropical Africa. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. Research suggests that Alternanthera helleri has therapeutic actions such as reducing oxidative stress, modulating the immune system, and exhibiting antiproliferative effects. The bioactive constituents of Alternanthera helleri include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
